I will keep this plot low-cost because my land is very small and cash is tight. I own this piece, so I will put manure where I can, but I will not risk much money on chemicals unless I already have a subsidy or can share with someone, and this season I will not count on that. I will plant improved maize seed if I can get a small pack, because I have seen other farmers do better with it, but I will not buy pesticide and I will wait for the rains instead of irrigating. Most of the work I will do with family on planting, weeding, and harvesting.
